name: image-to-code
title_zh: 先自己画设计图再照着写码的网页还原师
tagline_zh: 视觉重要的页面不再靠猜。它先按分区生成大尺寸设计图，逐块分析后再写代码，还原度比直接截小图硬抄高一个量级。
tagline_en: Stop guessing layouts for pixel-sensitive pages. It renders large section-wise design images first, analyzes.
desc_en: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping o
why_zh: 机制上反着来：不是「看图写码」，而是「先造图再写码」。每块独立生成高清设计图，避免压缩拼图丢失细节。
why_en: It flips the pipeline: generate fresh, high-res section images first, then implement against them—no tiny compressed boards, no.
limit_zh: 只服务 Codex 环境；若任务对视觉还原要求不高，它会多花一倍时间画图。产物止于前端代码，不含设计稿导出或部署。
limit_en: Codex-only; overkill for non-visual tasks (doubles time). Outputs front-end code only—no design file export or deployment. Requires image-gen API.
title_en: Web coder that draws its own design first, then codes to.
